offer.text: My sibling and I parted on hard words, and pride keeps us both silent. Carry a single poppy to them for me — they'll know what it means.

accept.text: Thank you. One flower can say what I can't.

decline.text: Then the silence stretches on, I suppose.

in_progress.text: Have you reached my sibling with the flower?

ready.text: They took it? And didn't throw it back? That's a start.

complete.text: We spoke tonight, first time in months. You mended what pride near broke. Thank you.
